claim_boundary: Exploratory real-data development evidence. The dataset has no writer identifiers, so this is not writer-disjoint confirmation, independent reproduction, SOTA evidence, or unrestricted efficacy evidence.

dataset.license: BSD-3-Clause data distributed with scikit-learn; derived from UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits

experimental_unit: exact-feature group after averaging repeated out-of-fold predictions within group

hardware.required: CUDA GPU with at least 8 GiB total memory

hypotheses.contrast: anchor_topk minus direct_multi averaged across declared noise levels
hypotheses.decision: effect >= 0.01, lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > 0, Holm-adjusted one-sided permutation p < 0.05
effect >= 0.01, lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > 0, Holm-adjusted one-sided permutation p < 0.05

hypotheses.contrast: anchor_topk minus fixed logistic regression averaged across declared noise levels
hypotheses.decision: effect >= -0.01, lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > -0.01, and Holm-adjusted one-sided permutation p against the -0.01 margin < 0.05

hypotheses.contrast: original_topk minus anchor_topk mean state displacement
hypotheses.decision: effect >= 0.1 and lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > 0.1

inference.estimand: unweighted mean across exact-feature groups; repeated split, row, and declared-noise observations are averaged inside each group before inference
inference.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across three accuracy hypotheses

model.prototype_fit: deterministic farthest-first on training rows only

negative_control.design: 20 deterministic training-label permutations in repeat 0 fold 0 at zero noise, evaluated with anchor_topk

supersession_reason: R1 omitted the original-query anchor term and did not apply top-k retrieval; R2 corrects both before any admitted GPU/data run.
